comparison.objective: Extract one connector terminal; record hangs two glasses in an overhead rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed lock-tab manipulation versus narrow-stem grasping, end-entry, sliding, lowering, and careful release under an overhead channel.
comparison.success_condition: Selective undamaged extraction versus both glasses hanging straight by their feet, released and still, with permanent failure for knockover. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The rack-engagement trajectory and fragile handling are unrelated to terminal depinning.
